title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 金刚身发动 / Rock Steady Activated
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 64 - Rock Steady Activated

preimages.meaning: 中文：把金刚身最终失败返回改为成功。 / English: Change the final Rock Steady failure return to success.

known_risks: 中文：通过强制 JP v96 中该效果 ID 的全部直接检查来激活语义；PPC 编译器复制/合并的路径数量与 3DS ARM 不完全相同，需要实机逐场景验证。 / English: Activates the semantic effect by forcing every direct JP-v96 check for its effect ID; PPC compiler duplication/consolidation differs from the 3DS ARM build and requires gameplay verification across contexts.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #64“金刚身发动”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #64 "Rock Steady Activated" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
